# ADR-013: Operational Status Generated by Runtime Only

## Status
Accepted (spec §4/ADR-013, §67)

## Context
If the model can declare "done", it can lie; task state must reflect reality.

## Decision
Only `server/task/GoalVerifier` may transition VERIFYING → COMPLETED. RUNNING/FAILED/COMPLETED/
progress counters are produced by the runtime from observed world state. The LLM may produce
conversation, short explanations and clarifying questions only. Completion/failure/permission-
denial messages shown to players are rendered by the Runtime first.

## Consequences
- Benchmark success = final world state satisfies the Goal Verifier, not LLM replies (spec §91).
